Maadi Branch
Why Choose Us in Maadi?
Proudly serving one of Cairo’s most pet-friendly neighborhoods, our Ma’adi location offers comprehensive veterinary services, from routine wellness visits to x-rays, lab testing, surgery, and emergency care. Our friendly team is here to keep your pets healthy and happy, year-round.
Book your pet’s visit today — we’re here 7 days a week in the heart of Ma’adi.
